notes: CardDemo's add-transaction screen (transaction CT02, program COTRN02C): the account (through the CXACAIX alternate index) or the card (CCXREF) is looked up in the card cross-reference, every field is validated -- the dates through CALL 'CSUTLDTC' (CEEDAYS; the COBOL side links CardDemo's CSUTLDTC and tests/equivalence/le/ceedays.c, the Java side its proven port from carddemo-dateutil) -- and on confirmation the new transaction id is the last id + 1, found by a HIGH-VALUES STARTBR and a READPREV, and WRITEn. PF5 copies the last transaction's data. Each scenario's TRANSACT file is compared after the task; it is loaded from CardDemo's own dailytran.txt (the same 350-byte layout).
